sections.title: Housing
data: The Eureka housing site has 58 family homes of 2 to 4 bedrooms and 8 homes for unaccompanied members. The sector also has 4 leased apartments in Crescent City and 7 family homes in Fort Bragg, California, for members of Station Noyo River.
In the Coast Guard, assignment to government housing is generally mandatory when a home is available. A release from the housing officer is needed before you rent in town and before BAH starts.
